summary: Register Robokassa as a third payment provider (create/status/reconcile/webhook) reusing the existing SBP/YooKassa PaymentGateway boundary; refund fails closed since no merchant refund API exists.

impacts.evidence: Robokassa accounts are tenant-scoped Connector SDK accounts identical in shape to sbp/yookassa; no cross-tenant credential or state sharing is introduced.
Login/Password1/Password2 stay behind the opaque SecretAccessor boundary; no PAN/CVV or raw provider payload is retained beyond bounded remote id/status/amount.
Robokassa reuses the existing /payments and /api/v1/webhooks/payments/{connector_id}/... routes verbatim; no new HTTP/OpenAPI operation is added.
Robokassa reuses the existing payment_status_changed/refund_status_changed outbox events; no new EventBus schema is added.

sdk.PaymentWebhook gains an additive Ack field so a provider transport can carry a non-generic acknowledgment body without the frozen Connector/Runtime roots or the HTTP webhook layer branching on connector identity.
No schema change: the existing payments/payment_refunds/payment_webhook_receipts tables from migration 000018 are already provider-neutral.

Fixed services.robokassa.ru/auth.robokassa.ru hosts, opaque three-part credential behind SecretAccessor, HMAC-MD5/MD5 signature verification, bounded inputs and normalized errors preserve the provider boundary. RefundPayment returns a normalized unsupported error with no network call rather than a faked success, since Robokassa has no merchant-level refund API.
Payment creation/refund remain gated by the same payments.create/payments.refund capability checks as sbp/yookassa; robokassa's operational_capabilities intentionally excludes payments.refund.
Status/webhook transitions flow through the existing ChangePaymentStatus/RecordWebhookEvidence audit and outbox path; no new evidence shape is introduced.
InvId is derived deterministically from ExternalID via FNV-1a so retries of the same logical payment are idempotent; webhook deliveries are deduplicated by the existing delivery_id evidence table.

VerifyPaymentWebhook checks the ResultURL MD5 signature and then re-fetches state via OpStateExt before accepting any status change, never trusting the callback body directly, matching ADR-0071/ADR-0105.
Non-2xx responses and malformed bodies are normalized to bounded errors; State.Code values outside the documented 100/10 stay pending rather than being guessed.
Robokassa can be disabled by removing its connector accounts; no destructive migration is involved.

Provider tests, go build/vet/test and the Task-064 conformance candidate pass 12 of 13 checks; sandbox_isolation could not be exercised because this execution environment cannot create unprivileged Linux user namespaces (unshare --user: Operation not permitted), an environment constraint shared by every connector's Task-029 probe, not a Robokassa-specific defect. docs/connectors/robokassa/conformance-report.json records this genuine result rather than a fabricated pass.
